```sql
SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ch_num.effective_month = '2026-05' THEN ch_num.population ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / 
  NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ch_den.effective_month = '2026-04' THEN ch_den.population ELSE 0 END), 0) AS result
FROM main."country" c
LEFT JOIN main."country_history" ch_num ON c."Code" = ch_num.code AND ch_num.effective_month = '2026-05'
LEFT JOIN main."country_history" ch_den ON c."Code" = ch_den.code AND ch_den.effective_month = '2026-04'
WHERE c."Continent" = 'Asia'
```
